end_card.headline: $49 Discovery Visit
lines: Every session with your PT, never a tech

ugc-tried-everything.quote: I have seen several of the so called best pain doctors and physical therapist in Little Rock to no avail. He has me back to playing golf again.

pov-rushed-pt.quote: No techs, no assistants, just him. After years of pain, it has only taken 5 visits with Brian.

pov_closer: At Pinnacle, every session is with your physical therapist. Never a tech or an aide.
